exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection (grouped by pre-VOC, Alpha/Gamma, Delta, Omicron variant eras)
cohort: The study included 870 placentas from pregnancies complicated by SARS-CoV-2 infection, specifically 90 from the Alpha/Gamma era, 60 from the Delta era, and 56 from the Omicron era.
finding: Features of maternal vascular malperfusion (MVM), including decidual arteriopathy, were significantly more frequent after SARS-CoV-2 infection, with the highest rates observed in the Delta era, and these associations were strengthened by increased COVID-19 severity and the presence of comorbidities.
cross-section timing: Data was collected across pre-VOC, Alpha & Gamma, Delta, and Omicron variant eras of SARS-CoV-2 predominance.
